description: This is an HTML file that implements a web-based database viewer interface. It contains HTML structure, CSS styles, and embedded JavaScript code to load and display database names, tables, and data samples interactively.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays list of databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes database list, resets UI state.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data rows into an HTML table.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell content, handling object expansion and long content.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expansion of long cell content or object for detailed view.
